newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: High dollar keeps European feeds quietly.
newsitem.headline: High dollar keeps European feeds quietly.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market opened quietly this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets $3 to $6 lower, following last night's weaker Chicago soymeal futures close and a stronger dollar.
Most other products were offered around $2 lower on the back of the stronger dollar.
Despite the weaker seller prices no trades were reported during the early stages of the market.
"There is already little buying mood and the high dollar killed off most of the interest left," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
